handoffs: A03-Congress-Ethics-Watch: The House voted 413-2 on September 1 to adopt H. Res. 1498, censure Republican Representative Chuck Edwards after the House Ethics Committee found persistent unprofessional and inappropriate conduct toward two young female staffers and violations related to sexual harassment and hostile work environment. The official House Clerk recorded the vote and censure pronouncement, and the House Ethics Committee report is the primary finding. AP, The Washington Post, CBS News, Axios, and Roll Call independently reported the action. Edwards said he exercised poor judgment but that regret was not an admission of sexual harassment; he previously disputed the committee's conclusions. This is a congressional ethics matter, not an A01 executive-branch event. Sources: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2026292; https://clerk.house.gov/Static/; https://ethics.house.gov/committee-reports/in-the-matter-of-allegations-relating-to-representative-chuck-edwards/; https://apnews.com/article/7cd5aa1f9d249d2c59b5ae7a149c0e7d; https://www.cbsnews.com/news/chuck-edwards-censure-vote-house-sexual-harassment/
